summary: Both blocking findings are valid and should be repaired in spec.json before spec-gate.

items.title: Expected Issue has no CLI integration point
items.rationale: The spec requires a machine-readable mismatch error but does not define the command surface that receives the expected Issue, so implementation and tests cannot target the behavior.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[0]; spec.json currently mentions flow entry / dispatcher boundary but does not name an expected-Issue argument or check command.

items.title: RunId status guidance conflicts with preparing autoApprove status
items.rationale: Preparing status intentionally reports autoApprove false, so the spec must distinguish active-flow runId status checks from prelude set-auto result semantics.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[1]; src/flow/lib/get-status.js comments that autoApprove is always false in preparing state, while set-auto can trust a preparing autoCheck result.
